_about: SHELF of classical Japanese literature in English before 1931 that no other shelf held: Dickins's Primitive & Mediaeval Japanese Texts (1906), Chamberlain's Classical Poetry of the Japanese (1880), Pierson's Manyosu book I (1929), Porter's Hundred Verses (the Hyakunin isshu, 1909) and Miscellany of a Japanese Priest (Kenko, 1914), and Sansom's Tsuredzure Gusa (1911). Waley's Genji and Pillow-Book, Mitford's Tales of Old Japan, the Chushingura, the Noh plays and the Diaries of Court Ladies are on other shelves. Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only; the Tuttle and AMS reprints are not used. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 76); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator names only: fetch_shelf.py treats them as the identity check.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.
